name: conductor-engine-agents
description: Full agent roster for the Conductor Engine, mapped to engine roles and subagent implementations.

supervisor.description: Top-level orchestrator. The only path through which capabilities execute.

workflow-orchestrator.description: Coordinates planner -> worker -> supervisor -> validator sequence for workflow goals.

planner.description: Breaks workflow goals into ordered PlanSteps.

worker.description: Turns PlanSteps into concrete TaskSubmissions for supervisor execution.

validator.description: Assesses workflow results and produces pass/fail verdicts.

capability-registry.description: Manages built-in and plugin-loaded capabilities. Registry is read by supervisor for dispatch.

policy-engine.description: Evaluates tasks before execution — allow, deny, or require approval.

guardrails.description: Validates task input schema and path safety before PENDING is left.

task-store.description: Persists TaskRecords at every state transition. Deep-copy reads.

event-bus.description: Fire-and-forget event emission for task lifecycle events (started/completed/failed/retry/escalated).

control-plane.description: Versioned HTTP FastAPI control-plane: tasks, capabilities, workflows, events, health, snapshot, cluster.

scheduler.description: Cron and webhook trigger adapters with polling scheduler lifecycle.

guild.description: Cross-project failure knowledge base with peer suggestions (Phase 6).
